title: Structural Health Monitoring of Dams Based on Acoustic Monitoring, Deep Neural Networks, Fuzzy Logic and a CUSUM Control Algorithm
summary: The framework identified structural-state changes; signal mobility/complexity tracked model homogeneity and activity correlated with water flow. Evidence comes from a scale-model experiment, not a full-size operating dam; threshold tuning and normal-state data remain limitations described by the authors.
ai_technology: A deep autoencoder models Hjorth acoustic features, with CUSUM and fuzzy logic detecting experimental changes in a scale-model dam.
